description: Prevention and school screening outreach: PPE and referral path, consent before screening, privacy screens and kit in order, screening steps the same way every time, close and file. Screening is not diagnosis: flag, refer, and record — never diagnose in the field. Demo programme inspired by Unspoken Smiles' public work — not official, not endorsed, not affiliated. Simulation only — not certification and not clinical hours.

stations.title: Safety station — PPE, first aid, extinguisher
Check-in table — welcome, consent forms, queue
Screening table — kit case, privacy screens, oversized brush

steps.action: PPE check + confirm the referral path before screening starts.
Welcome families and confirm consent before any screening.
Set the privacy screens, lay the kit out in order.
Run the screening steps the same way every time; flag and refer — never diagnose.
Close the queue, file the forms, and debrief with the coach.
